title: Rain on the Vent
setup: Rain on the hatch for the first time since. The gutter by the vent is overflowing, and it's mostly water.

options.label: Set every pot under the gutter
options.outcome: Four rations of grey water and a damp sleeve. Nobody drinks it until it's filtered.

options.label: Let it run off
options.outcome: The rain runs down the street. Somebody downhill has a very full gutter.

options.label: Filter it as it comes in

effects.what: filtered the rain as it fell

options.outcome: It drips through the filter all evening. Four rations of water that taste faintly of bottle.

title: The Toilet Tank
setup: {name} remembers the toilet tank upstairs. Twelve litres, untouched since the blast, behind a door that still locks.

options.label: Go up and drain it
options.outcome: Two buckets come down the ladder, and some of the street comes with them on {name}'s clothes.

options.label: Leave it for now
options.outcome: It will still be there. So will the dust on the stairs.

options.label: Go up masked

effects.what: kept the dust out on the stairs

options.outcome: Two buckets, no dust in anyone's lungs. The water needs filtering; the lungs don't.

title: A Bucket of Grey
setup: The dirty water has sat in the bucket for days. It is wet. That is the kindest thing anyone has said about it.

options.label: Drink it as it is
options.outcome: Two rations of something like water. Stomachs will have opinions by morning.

options.label: Wait for a way to filter it
options.outcome: The bucket stays under the vent. Everyone pretends not to look at it.

options.label: Pour it on the plants nobody has
options.outcome: It goes down the drain. The bucket is clean, at least.

title: Sharp Edges
setup: Taking things apart has its own hazards. {subject} found the sharpest part of a toaster with the palm of one hand.

options.label: Rinse it and wrap it in a sock
options.outcome: The sock is not sterile. Nobody says so.

options.label: Tell them it's fine
options.outcome: {subject} is told it's fine. It is a cut, and it knows it.

options.label: Bind it with a rag bandage
options.outcome: Boiled rag, tight wrap. The cut closes clean.

options.label: Use the medkit
options.outcome: Proper gauze for a small cut. It feels like using the good plates.

title: Cans in the Dark
setup: The cans on the ladder rattled at three in the morning. Someone is halfway down, holding very still.

options.label: Shout and switch on every light

then.text: They went back up the ladder empty-handed.

options.outcome: Lights, noise and a lot of swearing on both sides of the hatch.

options.label: Let them take something and go
options.outcome: They take one thing and close the hatch quietly behind them. Almost polite.

options.label: Meet them on the ladder with the pipe

effects.what: sent a thief back up the ladder

options.outcome: One swing into the dark. The ladder empties fast.

options.label: Show them the rifle
options.outcome: The thief looks at the rifle, then at the ladder, and picks the ladder.

title: Opening Night
setup: {subject} has made a stage out of a shoebox and wants a show tonight. Nobody has rehearsed anything.

options.label: Improvise a shadow play
options.outcome: {name} does a convincing rabbit and an unconvincing dragon. The audience is generous.

options.label: Not tonight
options.outcome: The shoebox stage goes under the bunk for another night.

options.label: Bring out the sock puppets

effects.what: a full show in a shoebox

options.outcome: Two socks, three acts and a standing ovation from the bunk beds.

options.label: Card tricks instead

effects.what: one card trick, done eleven times

options.outcome: The same trick eleven times. It gets the same gasp every time.
